Docs/Policy integration

Policy integration

Map observations and model outputs into the registered joint-space interface without altering the task.

The adapter boundary

  1. Read the environment’s action space, registered robot and camera profile.
  2. Convert image streams, proprioception and the canonical instruction into your model’s input schema.
  3. Convert the predicted action chunk to absolute joint targets in the environment’s exact joint order.
  4. Execute the chunk at 20 Hz; preserve success, termination and truncation signals.
  5. For a sequence, update the policy or instruction at stage transitions without resetting the simulator.

Model coordinates are not controller coordinates

The GR00T adapter uses relative arm offsets internally and converts them back to absolute targets for pd_joint_pos. An adapter must not pass relative offsets directly to that controller. Sharpa hand targets remain absolute.

ContractRecord with the policy
ObservationImage keys/order, resolution, state features, normalization and history.
ActionJoint order, absolute/relative conversion, units, chunk size and execution rate.
LanguageInstruction version and stage-transition rule.
ProvenanceCheckpoint, adapter revision, training data and environment source revision.

Inspect algo/groot.py, train/train_groot.py and train/train_configs/groot_config.py for the implemented reference path. Other hands have their own spaces; the Sharpa 29/58-D layout is not universal.

Local integration, not a remote policy service

DexArena currently documents local code paths. A hosted evaluation API or RoboDojo’s XPolicyLab integration is not part of the verified DexArena release.
